en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Aban, from Abdul Rahman Bin Ayn who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Whenever the man intends to get marry the woman, so let him say, ‘I accept with the Covenant which Allahazwj has Taken [2:229] then keep (them) in good fellowship or let (them) go with kindness’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Aban from ‘Abd af-Rahman ibn ‘ A‘yan who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘
When a man wants to marry a woman he should say, “I authenticate my covenant with Allah which is: “maintain in a reasonable way or allow to go with kindness.” [2:229]’”
